payload.title: Projected pages can follow a host site's colour-scheme switch
payload.description: Backlog. A core projection.json option such as colorScheme {strategy: class, className: dark, storageKey: <key>} that emits the pre-paint script and class, instead of each site writing it in a head_extra hook. Gherkin to be written when picked up. Today a site does this with the head_extra hook (Data Parade does).
